name: nexus_get_mod_files
description:
List all files attached to a mod with versions, sizes, and update chain [v1 - uses v1 REST quota].

Returns:
    JSON {files: [...], file_updates: [{old_file_id, new_file_id, ...}]}.
    File category_id mapping: 1=MAIN, 2=UPDATE, 3=OPTIONAL, 4=OLD_VERSION,
    6=DELETED, 7=ARCHIVED.

category.description: Optional comma-separated file-category filter (case-insensitive). Valid values: main, update, optional, old_version, miscellaneous.
category.title: Category

domain_name.description: Nexus Mods game domain (lowercase URL slug), e.g. 'forzahorizon6', 'skyrimse'. NOT the display name.
domain_name.title: Domain Name
